components.title: Filter and deduplicate orders in range
components.what: Identify all unique orders (removing exact duplicate rows) dated from 2026-05-12 to 2026-06-10 inclusive, regardless of status.

components.title: Compute median unit price
components.what: Sort the resulting unit prices and calculate the median (average of two middle values if even count), rounded to two decimal places.
